name: MKT_CM_STG_LSTOUTPTS
description: This table stores the reference to output list files generated in a Marketing Campaign Stage. When a marketing campaign stage gets executed during a campaign load/launch process, list files are generated which contain the list of targeted customers. This entity is kind of an internal tracking entity which tracks details about the list files generated.

columns.name: LSTOUTPT_ID
columns.description: Primary Key Column

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Document Id in content repository.

columns.name: CAMPAIGN_ID
columns.description: Campaign Id. FK to MKT_CM_CAMPAIGNS table.

columns.name: STAGE_ID
columns.description: Stage Id. FK to MKT_CM_STAGES table.

columns.name: STG_EXEC_ID
columns.description: Stage Execution Id. FK to MKT_CM_STG_EXECS table.

columns.name: FILE_NAME
columns.description: Output List File Name

columns.name: FILE_PATH
columns.description: Output List File Path

columns.name: FILE_SIZE
columns.description: Output List File Size

columns.name: RECORD_CNT
columns.description: Output List Record Count

columns.name: DELV_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Delivery Status Code

columns.name: DELV_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Delivery Profile Id. FK to MKT_TM_DLV_PROFILE table.

columns.name: TREATMENT_ID
columns.description: Treatment Id. FK to MKT_TM_TREATMENTS table.

columns.name: CALL_LST_ID
columns.description: Call List Id. FK to MKT_CALL_LST table.

columns.name: BATCH_NUM
columns.description: Output List File Batch Number

columns.name: DESC_TXT
columns.description: Description Text

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
